DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 → CAN communication lost → possible CAN cable or XD16

additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R4 170001819
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
BQaC7f
Problem Description
: Outlet 2 out of order
Troubleshooting
:
This error only occurred one time for the last month.
I checked the logs and found the following:
Seems like the CAN communication was lost for some reason and returned afterwards.
You should, preventively, check these connections so that it doesn't happen again. Since it only occurred once I can only speculate on what the root cause might be, which is either:
CAN cable is loose
XD16-13:A/B or XD16-14C/D
KF11 input CAN 1L or 1h
Since the error is no longer present, let me know if this information is enough for you to troubleshoot and I can close the ticket.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0381648
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
